replies.author: Gundham
replies.body:
The map looks amazing! I like how the map is distributed evenly through the space you used. Not too few/too much void, alright amount of islands, very alrighty aesthetically, shape of the map is really impressive. I like what you did here!
Only downsides I can really point out are the small amount of layers, therefore tunneling wouldn't be allowed. And you should totally add a spawn structure, it looks nicer that way :(

Anyways...
As long as you do something about the first issue I pointed out:

The map is better suited for those numbers.

replies.author: Gundham
replies.body:
The max player capacity per team on Nebula maps is of 25 players per team, therefore 30vs30 won't be possible.

I think 15vs15 is alrighty, however if you want to increase the cap 20vs20 wouldn't be a problem since I believe that map can hold up to that number perfectly.
